name: aasb-aas-mobile-app-builder
description: Install the "AAS Mobile App Builder" workflow plugin from Agentic Awesome Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Mobile implementation and platform interface guidance.
interface.longDescription: Mobile implementation and platform interface guidance. Build mobile features with React Native, Expo, Flutter or iOS, including platform design, API states and release checks. Recommended for: Mobile teams, Expo and React Native builders, Cross-platform app maintainers. Not for: Desktop-only applications, App-store submission, signing credentials or device testing supplied by the plugin. Covers Mobile Developer, React Native Architecture, and 17 more skills.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this mobile app and its chosen Expo, React Native, Flutter or native iOS stack. Implement the requested feature, check platform-specific behavior and offline/error states, and prepare build and store-readiness checks. Identify device, SDK and signing requirements before claiming verification.
Use this plugin to plan a React Native feature from routing and state to test and release.
Use this plugin to compare Flutter, React Native, native iOS, and multi-platform tradeoffs for this app.

Review this project for the added coverage: Build native iOS screens using the existing navigation and UI conventions; Connect client UI to APIs with explicit state, validation and error handling. Use only the relevant skills and existing stack. Report observed checks and limitations; prepare drafts before external or production actions.
